license_policy.note: test/licenses.test.mjs reads this file. The keys follow the §11 JSON block, except aip_cycle_current: T-K05 takes the cycle from test/fixtures/aip_vtbd_current.json. Every change to this file needs the owner's approval in the pull request, above all one that weakens a check: removing an entry from forbidden_sources, forbidden_sources_dirs, forbidden_extensions_in_repo, required_footer_terms, conditional_footer_terms or odbl_derived_files, adding one to forbidden_sources_skip, gpl_guard_allowlist or legacy_data_without_fields, or changing code_license. test/licenses.test.mjs also pins the §11 minimum of most of these lists.

code_license.decided: the owner, on a decision card, 2026-11-25 (research round 5 §12 P3-9)
code_license.scope: the code (src/, test/, tools/, build.mjs and every script, those in docs/research included) and the repository's own text (README, CLAUDE.md, the research reports); the files in data/ follow data/LICENSE-DATA.md (ODbL 1.0 for the OpenStreetMap-derived ones), data files and quoted material in docs/research that state their own licence (ODbL, CC BY 4.0, Copernicus data) keep it, and AIP values are used as numbers with CAAT cited

license_policy.required_footer_terms_note: §11 footer_proposed_th. Each pane of the page (explore and train) carries them, since a pane hides the other while it is open.
license_policy.forbidden_sources_note: Matched without regard to case. §11 table 11.3 forbids X-Plane 12 CIFP (navigation data), which CIFP covers; the §11 JSON's bare X-Plane is left out, so that citing an X-Plane manual as a design reference (round 1 §11, input research) stays allowed.
license_policy.odbl_derived_files_note: §11 lists the JSON files; data/land_in.png and data/land_out.png are added here because tools/landclass.py classifies them from OpenStreetMap renders (src/48-data.js credits them to OpenStreetMap contributors). A data JSON file whose source names OpenStreetMap or OSM, or whose license names ODbL, must be on this list, so that README and data/LICENSE-DATA.md list it too.
license_policy.legacy_data_without_fields_note: §11 item 3 asks for top-level source and license fields in every new JSON file under data/ (or in _meta, where a parameter card whose leaves follow {v, u, scope, ...} keeps its metadata). data/vtbd_af.json and data/city.json predate the rule and received the fields on 2026-11-26; the list stays, empty, for any future file that cannot carry them.
